entities.summary: Liverpool FC confirmed that Diogo Jota passed away at age 28 following a road traffic accident in Spain, alongside his brother Andre Silva.
entities.report_summary: 利物浦官方确认，Diogo Jota（若塔）已于2025年7月3日去世，官方说明他是在西班牙交通事故后离世，同行的兄弟 Andre Silva 也不幸遇难。
entities.editorial_rule: Any report mentioning this player must describe the official source-backed death, not injury absence, squad rotation, transfer availability, or ordinary match unavailability.
